title.en: QA read-only review of the R06 multi-frame closeout governance (card notes and unchanged statuses, O1 backlog card, closeout evidence self-check, non-claims, no code changes)

intent.zh: 对收口治理卡 `2026-11-05-render-r06-multiframe-closeout`（verified；登记 8f376ae0、start 73f33bd6、实现 6af1d83d）做**只读一致性复核**（HEAD 6af1d83d）：① tracking 卡 `2026-11-04-render-r06-flex-multiframe` 与 roadmap 卡 `2026-10-11-roadmap-r06-p8` 仅 note + updated_at 变更，`status/title/acceptance/depends_on` 逐字未动，状态仍 **backlog / proposed**；② 两卡 note 含 G-2/G-3 覆盖 + 边界（单场景 scene-flex、3 帧 0/+0.10/+0.20 m、帧内位级 + 跨帧可见性；动画通用性/多场景/长序列未覆盖）+ spec `1d9fa5ce…` 未变 + 证据指针（G-2 `5f2bd0bb`/`38a7767c`、G-3 `b3a05f2b`、复核 `d8fc8eeb`），roadmap note 写明「广度未覆盖保持 proposed、不宣称整族」；③ O1 backlog 卡 `2026-11-05-render-r06-multiframe-guards-eol-backlog` status backlog/p15 且今晚未改 `.gitattributes`；O2/O3 记已知入收口证据；④ 收口证据 manifest 2/2 自核、UTF-8/LF/无 BOM/裸 CR-TAB 0；⑤ 边界：仅 7 个文件变更、`unchanged src/tests/fixtures/scripts` 与既有证据目录、无越界声明。**只读 + 写自己的证据目录；CPU-only、零 GPU。**
intent.en: Read-only consistency review of the multi-frame closeout governance card at HEAD 6af1d83d: only note/updated_at changed on the two target cards with statuses preserved, notes carry the coverage boundary and evidence pointers, O1 backlog registered without .gitattributes change, closeout evidence self-check/encoding, scope and non-claim boundaries.

acceptance: **两卡仅 note+updated_at 变更、状态未变**：`git diff d8fc8eeb..6af1d83d` 对 tracking/roadmap 卡只有 note 与 updated_at 两行；`status` 仍 backlog/proposed；`title/acceptance/depends_on`（及其余字段）逐字未动。

**note 内容与证据指针**：tracking note 含「G-2 采集有效 + G-3 验证 PASS」、覆盖边界（单场景 scene-flex、3 帧 0/+0.10/+0.20 m、帧内位级 + 跨帧可见性、动画通用性/多场景/长序列未覆盖）、spec `1d9fa5ce…` 未变、证据指针 G-2 `5f2bd0bb`/`38a7767c` + G-3 `b3a05f2b` + 复核 `d8fc8eeb`；roadmap note 含「多帧子项已由 G-2/G-3 覆盖（3 帧集、单场景）、因广度未覆盖保持 proposed、不宣称整族通过」。

**O1 backlog 与 O2/O3 已知**：`2026-11-05-render-r06-multiframe-guards-eol-backlog` status=backlog/priority=15，note 记 guards JSON eol raw-vs-blob sha 与「今晚不改 .gitattributes」；O2/O3 写入收口证据 README §4/receipt `known_observations`。

**收口证据与边界**：`docs/development-evidence/render-bvh/r06-multiframe-closeout/` manifest 首行 `#`、2/2 自核、UTF-8/LF/无 BOM、裸 CR/TAB 0；变更范围 7 文件（两卡 + closeout 卡 + backlog 卡 + 3 证据文件）；`unchanged src/, tests/, fixtures/, scripts/` 与既有证据目录；无 `.gitattributes` 改动。
**无越界声明**：两卡 note 与收口证据中无「多帧验收通过 / 动画一致性已覆盖 / 上游等价」正向声明（精确词仅出现于 closeout 卡自身的 forbid_claim 词表与否定句）；不写发布依据。
**结论格式**：`PASS` / `PASS-with-observations` / `needs-fix` + 观察清单；证据落 `docs/development-evidence/render-bvh/r06-multiframe-closeout-check/`。
note: QA 自登记（Chief 2026-11-05 夜：收口治理卡落库后做一致性只读复核）。复核目标 HEAD 6af1d83d（登记 8f376ae0、start 73f33bd6、实现 6af1d83d）。只读复核：不改两卡/backlog 卡/收口证据/既有证据/代码/fixtures；CPU-only、零 GPU。
